mentions.title: Vasseur offers Ferrari upgrade promise to frustrated Leclerc
mentions.summary: Ferrari Team Principal Fred Vasseur has promised that the Maranello-based squad will bring developments to the SF-26 “soon” after Charles Leclerc cited a lack of recent development as a reason behind their poor form in Azerbaijan.

mentions.title: Red Bull won't deliver any more major F1 car upgrades in 2026
mentions.summary:
Red Bull has announced its Baku updates will be its final major Formula 1 car upgrade package as it shifts focus to 2027.
The Azerbaijan Grand Prix had already been circled in red for a long time as a venue for key upgrades to arrive, with Williams delivering a 'B-spec' car, while McLaren has arrived with significantly revised sidepods, among other changes.

mentions.title: Will the "big swing" Williams F1 car upgrade be a hit or a miss?
mentions.summary:
Williams is bringing a major update package to the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, one that team boss James Vowles promised earlier in the season would result in an "almost completely new" car.
What remains to be seen, at this late stage, is how useful it will be – both in terms of immediate performance uplift and the direction of 2027 development.
